rows.note: Use this as the everyday construction for the act of replacing a particular thing, such as a light bulb.

example.english: The light bulb has burned out, and the replacement will only take a few minutes.
example.traditional: 盞燈膽燒咗，換燈膽只係幾分鐘嘅事。
example.jyutping: zaan2 dang1 daam2 siu1 zo2 wun6 dang1 daam2 zi2 hai6 gei2 fan1 zung1 ge3 si6

rows.note: For a substitute object or product, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: This model of headphones was out of stock, so I bought another one as a replacement.
example.traditional: 呢款耳機冇貨，我買咗另一款做替代品。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 ji5 gei1 mou5 fo3 ngo5 maai5 zo2 ling6 jat1 fun2 zou6 tai3 doi6 ban2

rows.note: Use this for a person who stands in for another person, especially in a performance, job, or dangerous situation.

example.english: During the action scene, the actor hired a stunt double as a replacement for the dangerous jump.
example.traditional: 拍打戲嗰陣，演員請咗替身代佢跳樓。
example.jyutping: paak3 daa2 hei3 go2 zan6 jin2 jyun4 ceng2 zo2 tai3 san1 doi6 keoi5 tiu3 lau2
